result: Hardened mutation journaling so failed operations retain the journal for recovery, successful operations clear it, and commit rollback removes newly moved archives and restores mod-list state. Existing backend APIs and portal-side URL validation remain intact, but Mods UI, focused mod-specific tests, and bulk staged archive finalization as one transaction remain incomplete.

next_slice.summary: Complete Mods UI wiring and focused mod-specific tests; finish bulk update staged archive promotion in one commit path.

blockers: Compact Mods UI remains unwired for role/running guards, uninstall/bulk confirmation, profiles, and operation results.
Focused mod transaction/dependency/profile tests were not added.
Bulk update downloads remain staged without final archive promotion in the single commit path.
